name: already-covered-photographer
rule: If the act's own site explicitly states it already has a photographer (a Photographer in Residence, a House Photographer), set alreadyCoveredNote as a fit-risk flag for Dan (#611). It never blocks finding a contact or drafting.

sources.label: Aurora Strings own staff page
sources.content: Aurora Strings. Emma Robinson, Marketing Director: emma@aurorastrings.example. Photographer in Residence: our concert imagery is by our resident photographer.

expected.description: Still surface the act's marketing contact, and additionally set the already-covered fit-risk note.

results.alreadyCoveredNote: Aurora Strings' own staff page names a Photographer in Residence and says its concert imagery is by that resident photographer.

draft.subject: Photographing Aurora Strings' June 4 concert at Metro Concert Hall
draft.body: My name is Dan Wright and I'm a professional arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing in regard to your June 4 concert at Metro Concert Hall. I shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage, so the audience doesn't notice me and the playing isn't disturbed. I've been photographing at Carnegie Hall for close to ten years, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't have someone on it already, I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the performance. I look forward to hearing from you.
